name: markdown-format
description: Formats Markdown with markdownlint-cli2 once per batch of tool calls and at git pre-commit, and reports its lint findings at commit and, unless markdown_format_end_of_turn is false, at each turn end, only where a markdownlint config governs the file; formatting and linting are separate, and hooks never run an ecosystem record's command.

markdown_format_enabled.title: Format markdown after edits
markdown_format_enabled.description: After each batch of tool calls, run markdownlint-cli2 --fix over the Markdown files it wrote (runs only where a markdownlint config governs the file)

markdown_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
markdown_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves gitignored files alone: a scratch tier the repo excludes is not rewritten. Set true to bypass this hook's git check; markdownlint-cli2's own ignores and gitignore config still apply, so a path your markdownlint config excludes stays untouched.

markdown_format_end_of_turn.title: Check markdown in uncommitted changes at turn end
markdown_format_end_of_turn.description: When a turn ends, run the pre-commit lint entry over the uncommitted changes; nothing is rewritten. Unset (the default) shows markdownlint findings to you in a warning and the turn ends. true hands them back to Claude, at most once per turn. false runs no check.
